name: Someone to Queue
tagline: We stand in the queue. You turn up at the front.
summary: We queue for you, booked by the half hour, so you can arrive when it's nearly your turn.
concept: Some queues are long and the bit at the front is short. We do the long bit.
who_its_for: Anyone with a launch, a counter or a ticket office to get to and better things to do.
how_it_works: Choose how long you need: £9 per 30 minutes, minimum 1 hour, maximum 6 hours.
Book at least 24 hours ahead. Slots start on the hour, 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Saturday.
Tell us where the queue is, what it's for and when you'll arrive.
We hold your place. You take over at the front.

page.headline: Someone to stand in line
page.intro: We stand in the queue. You turn up at the front.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body: £9 per 30 minutes. Minimum 1 hour, maximum 6 hours.

sections.title: When
sections.body: Slots start on the hour from 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Saturday. Book 24 hours ahead.

sections.title: What we cannot do
sections.body: We cannot do the bit where you are served. We will not queue for anything that needs ID in your name.

faq.a: £9 per 30 minutes. The minimum is 1 hour (£18) and the maximum is 6 hours.

faq.q: How much notice do you need?

faq.a: On the hour, 08:00 to 18:00, Monday to Saturday.

faq.q: Can you buy it for me?
faq.a: No. We hold the place; you are served. We cannot do that part.
Anything that needs ID in your name, such as collecting a parcel or a passport.
Full refund up to 24 hours before. None after that.
At your chosen place within 30 miles of us.

faq.q: What if the queue moves faster than expected?
faq.a: You pay for the time booked. Tell us your arrival time and we'll aim to match it.
